# Neumorphism

Neumorphism applies soft shadows and subtle highlights so that interface elements read as raised or pressed. Its minimalist monochromatic palette is customizable and its typography is described as optimized for distraction-free reading and writing.

![Neumorphism screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lennzone/Neumorphism/HEAD/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Neumorphism"
    author: "lennzone"
    repo:   "lennzone/Neumorphism"
    slug:   "neumorphism"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/neumorphism"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/lennzone/Neumorphism"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lennzone/Neumorphism/HEAD/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Neumorphism styling with soft shadows and subtle highlights to give UI elements a tactile, raised or pressed 3D look. Customize a minimalist monochromatic palette and optimized typography for comfortable, distraction-free reading and writing."
}
```
